content.title: 倒装句·速查(否定前置 / Only+状语 / so·such…that / 虚拟省略)
content.intro: 倒装就是把正常的「主语+谓语」语序颠倒,用来强调或承前。常见为部分倒装:把助动词/情态动词/be 提到主语前(do/does/did + 主语 + 动词原形;had/have + 主语 + 过去分词)。判断口诀:句首是否定/only/so/such,主句就要倒装;从句不倒装。

rows: Never / Seldom / Rarely / Little / Hardly…when / No sooner…than
助动词提前:Never had I seen…;No sooner had we left than…
主句倒装:Not until then did the canal lose its importance.
Not only did it carry grain, but it also spread ideas.
Only + 副词/介词短语/状语从句
Only then did people realise…;Only by trying can we succeed.
So important was the canal that…;Such was the fame that…
Had I known…;Were it not for…;Should you visit…

specialRules.rule: 部分倒装只动助动词/情态/be,实义动词留原位、用原形
specialRules.mark: Only then did people realise(realise 用原形)

specialRules.rule: Not only A but also B:倒装只发生在 A(句首)部分,B 不倒装
specialRules.mark: Not only did it…, but it also proved…

specialRules.rule: so…that 提前的是形容词/副词;such…that 提前的是名词词组
specialRules.mark: So heavy were the boats…/ Such was his interest…

specialRules.rule: 虚拟条件省略 if 时把 had/were/should 提前;否定 not 留在主语后
specialRules.mark: Had the emperor not moved…(=If the emperor had not moved)

why: 英语把信息焦点放句尾;当强调成分(否定词、only、so/such)被提到句首时,只能靠倒装助动词来维持句子节奏并表强调,所以主语后才出现真正的谓语。
gaokaoPoints: 否定/半否定词置于句首必倒装(never/seldom/hardly/no sooner/not until/not only…);判断助动词时态与主谓一致是采分点。
Only + 状语 在句首使「主句」倒装,而非 only 后面的从句:Only when…did + 主语。
虚拟条件省略 if 的倒装(Had/Were/Should)是写作高分句型,常考语法填空与改错。

examVsReal.exam: Never had I seen such a sight.(考试/书面强调)
examVsReal.real: I had never seen anything like it.
examVsReal.note: 日常口语多用正常语序;倒装更书面、更强调。

examVsReal.exam: Had I known, I would have come.(考试虚拟倒装)
examVsReal.real: If I’d known, I would’ve come.
examVsReal.note: 口语保留 if、用缩略;倒装省 if 更正式。
